content.text: {"headline":"Approve R2 (break shift plus afternoon overtime, ₹720), but involve the duty manager now: even the best compliant plan only reaches about 66% against the 80% target.","why":"The general queue is running above forecast because of the MKT-2026-551 personal loan email sent at 09:00. Over the last four intervals there were 307 calls against 236 forecast, mostly loan_enquiry (92 vs 40) and new_offer_enquiry (50 vs 14), and service level fell to 68% at 09:45. This is extra demand, not a staffing shortfall. R2 delays general and payments breaks from 12:30-13:00 by 45 minutes, offers overtime to 11 general agents 14:00-16:00 and moves 4 cross-skilled agents from payments to general 15:00-16:00. It is predicted at 66.2% for 11:00-15:15 (general 59.8%, payments 74.5%) with 6.5% abandons, and 77.9% for the rest of the day. That is the best of the policy-compliant plans, but only marginally better than doing nothing (66.0%). Escalation is required under ESC-02 because the best compliant plan is below the 70% line.","trade_offs":["P0 (no action) costs nothing and is predicted at 66.0%, almost the same as R2. The ₹720 buys very little on the overall figure.","R1 costs the same ₹720 and gives general slightly more help (61.0% vs 59.8%). It is 65.9% overall and takes more from payments (72.3% vs 74.5%).","P1 is free but predicted lower at 63.7%. P4 costs ₹1,305 and reaches only 64.2%. Both are worse than R2.","P2 (₹225, 81.9%) and P3 (₹1,080, 82.3%) are the only plans that hit target, but they breach CX-01: a known-issue IVR message needs a confirmed outage or incident, and there is none. Only the duty manager could consider an alternative compliant message for these campaign calls."],"watch":"Watch general queue service level and abandons through 11:00-15:15, and check that payments holds near 74.5% while its breaks are shifted and agents move across. Ask the duty manager whether marketing can pause or adjust the campaign, or whether a compliant campaign IVR message can be approved, as the staffing options alone will not get close to 80%."}
